title: [Free browser beta] NEON AFTERHOURS — an ordinary office worker steps into a Hong Kong action movie
author: DueResponse2717
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’m the developer of **NEON AFTERHOURS**, a pixel-art action game inspired by Hong Kong cinema. The public beta is free to play in your browser:

[**Play on itch.io**](https://rexzen.itch.io/neon-afterhours)

Neon Afterhours follows a middle-aged salaryman escaping everyday life through action-film fantasies. Its pixel-art stages draw on classic Hong Kong movie scenes, with fast, lethal top-down combat inpired by Hotline Miami series with new objectives beyond clearing every enemy. Sneak through darkness to retrieve evidence, lure enemies into a car explosion, or retreat while holding a hostage. Between films, return to your apartment to listen to unlocked music and enjoy posters, figures, and outfits with gameplay perks.

The free browser beta supports keyboard/mouse and gamepad. I’d love feedback on controls, mission clarity, and any frustrating moments. Thank you for testing it out!

replies.author: DueResponse2717
replies.body: Indeed, I love those Miami titles! Expanded a few new mission mechanisms and fit some of my favorite movie scenes in.
